summary: Wayly Phase 2/3 expansion verified end-to-end. Backend: 21/21 new pytest tests pass (chat, chat history, family thread, participant today, wellbeing, dashboard share, public budget-calc, price-check, price-check/services, classification-check, reassessment-letter, auth/google-session). Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport, Expo web preview): 5-tab bar restructured (Today/Statements/Help/Family/More) renders correctly; login screen shows BOTH email/password sign-in AND 'Continue with Google' button (testID auth-google-button); chat tab sends message and renders user+assistant bubbles using emergentintegrations Claude Sonnet 4.5; family thread composer posts and appends messages live; More tab exposes all 7 expected links (participant view, AI tools, notifications, share dashboard, settings web, billing web, logout); Share Dashboard modal opens, accepts emails+note, sends; Participant view renders greeting, appointment card, all 3 mood buttons; tapping a mood records via /api/participant/wellbeing and shows thanks message; Tools index renders all 4 cards; Budget Calc, Price Checker, Classification Check, and Reassessment Letter (Claude, ~10s) all return result blocks. Letter has copy button. No red-screen errors, no React Native component issues, all interactive elements have testID, all text is wrapped in <Text>.

minor.issue: When EMERGENT_LLM_KEY or Claude is unreachable the endpoint silently returns a fallback string with HTTP 200 ("I'm having trouble reaching my brain…"). Suggest also returning a flag like {error: true} so the UI can render a retry affordance instead of treating it as a normal reply.
Endpoint accepts wellbeing posts even when the user has no household (h is None) — it stores household_id=None. Currently OK for demo, but consider a 400 when household is missing for clarity.
No pagination — returns up to 500 docs. Fine for now; flag for prod.
Carry-over from iteration_1: JWT_SECRET still 26 bytes; pyjwt logs InsecureKeyLengthWarning on every login.

react_native_issues.issue: Carry-over: "shadow*" style props deprecated warnings + props.pointerEvents deprecation warning on RN Web 0.20+. Non-blocking.
Expo doctor warns expo-clipboard@55.0.13 (expected ~8.0.8) and expo-web-browser@55.0.15 (expected ~15.0.11). Versions still work in preview but worth aligning before release.

action_items: (Optional) Have /api/chat surface a flag when the LLM call fails so the UI can show retry instead of a confusing fallback message.
(Optional) Reject /api/participant/wellbeing with 400 if no household is linked.
(Optional) Bump expo-clipboard and expo-web-browser to versions matching Expo SDK 54.
(Optional, carried over) Rotate JWT_SECRET to 32+ bytes.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 924 lines — Phase 2/3 added 9 endpoints inline. Recommend splitting into routers (chat.py, family.py, participant.py, public_tools.py, oauth.py) before Phase 4.
PRICE_BENCHMARKS is a dict literal in server.py — should live in /app/backend/data/ or a config module so the rate cap dataset can be updated independently of code.
Family-thread POST returns the inserted doc by snapshotting BEFORE motor mutates it with `_id` (good) — confirms no Mongo `_id` leak in the response.
All public tool endpoints are unauthenticated, which matches the spec (used for marketing/lead-gen) — make sure rate limiting is in place at the ingress level before launch.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data added. Tests rely on the auto-seeded demo user (demo@wayly.com.au / Wayly123!) and Margaret household. Test runs do append: ~3 chat turns, 1 family-thread message ('TEST_AUTOPLAY_…'), and a wellbeing entry per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase 2/3 endpoints + screens are functional. testIDs added in this phase: auth-google-button, chat-scroll-view, chat-starter-prompts, chat-starter-{prefix}, chat-bubble-{user|assistant}-{idx}, chat-input, chat-send-button, family-thread-scroll, family-thread-empty, family-message-{id}, family-message-input, family-send-button, profile-participant-view, profile-ai-tools, profile-notifications, profile-share-dashboard, profile-settings-web, profile-billing-web, share-sheet, share-emails-input, share-note-input, share-send, participant-back, participant-greeting, participant-appointment, wellbeing-{good|okay|not_great}, wellbeing-thanks, tools-scroll, tool-{budget-calc|price-checker|classification-check|reassessment-letter}, budget-class-{1..8}, budget-grandfathered, budget-balance, budget-burn, budget-calc-button, budget-result, price-service-{slug}, price-rate-input, price-check-button, price-result, class-q-{i}, class-q-{i}-{0..4}, class-submit, class-result, reassess-participant, reassess-sender, reassess-changes, reassess-events, reassess-generate, reassess-result, reassess-copy. Reassessment letter takes 5–15s (Claude). Single environmental 'fail' in playwright run — chat starter prompts didn't render because the chat history collection already had entries from the pytest run that ran seconds earlier; this is expected behavior, not a bug. The starter prompts ARE wired correctly — they show only when history is empty. To verify on a fresh DB, drop chat_turns first.
rca_of_issue: No outstanding bugs. The single failed UI assertion (chat starter prompts) is a test-ordering artifact: the backend pytest suite runs /api/chat which inserts user+assistant turns into chat_turns, so when the playwright run subsequently opens the Help tab, history is non-empty and the empty-state starter prompts are correctly suppressed. Confirmed by the fact that the very next steps (sending a new message, rendering user+assistant bubbles) succeed.
